notices.text: A new Congress starts on January 3, 2027. The Speaker of the House and some senators and representatives may change. If your interview is on or after that date, give the name of the person serving on your interview day. Check uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates.
Many states elected a governor in November 2026. New governors take office in January 2027. If your interview is in January 2027 or later, give the name of the governor serving on your interview day.
